content.title: Iowa basketball vs. Clemson: What to know about Hawkeyes' first NCAA Tournament game
content.text: Iowa is in the NCAA Tournament in Ben McCollum's first season in charge.The Hawkeyes earned a No. 9 seed on Selection Sunday and will play No. 8 seed Clemson in the opening round.KCCI's Cullen Holt will be in Tampa when the Hawkeyes take the floor. Here's what to know about Friday's game.Iowa vs. Clemson: How to watch and stream the Hawkeyes' NCAA Tournament gameWhen: 5:50 p.m. CT, Friday, March 20Where: Benchmark International Arena, TampaTV: TNTLivestream: March Madness LiveNCAA Tournament tickets for Iowa vs. Clemson in TampaIowa and Clemson will be part of Session 2 in Tampa. You can find tickets here.Want to go to every NCAA Tournament game in Tampa? You can get all-session tickets here.What to know about Clemson, Iowa's first-round NCAA Tournament opponentAs expected with an 8/9 matchup, Clemson and Iowa are evenly matched. The Hawkeyes actually come in 11 spots ahead of Clemson in KenPom despite being the lower seed.The Tigers are 24-10 this year in their 16th season under head coach Brad Brownell. They have made the NCAA Tournament three years in a row, including an Elite Eight run in 2024 as a No. 6 seed.Clemson plays at a slow pace. The Tigers rank No. 333 out of 365 Division I teams in adjusted pace and opposing offenses use nearly 19 seconds of the shot clock on average against Clemson's defense, which ranks No. 359.Clemson is balanced offensively. Senior forward RJ Godfrey leads the team with 11.9 points per game (61% shooting) and seven other Tigers average between 10.2 and 5.4 points per game.One problem for the Tigers: they will be without 6-foot-10 center Carter Welling after he tore his ACL in the ACC Tournament. Welling was the team's leading rebounder (5.4 per game) and was second on the team in scoring (10.2 points per game).WATCH: Hawkeyes head to Tampa for first round of NCAA tournamentIowa vs. Clemson basketball historyIowa and Clemson have met four times. Iowa leads the series 3-1.Nov. 25, 2022: Iowa 74, Clemson 71 (Niceville, Florida)Nov. 29, 2011: Clemson 71, Iowa 55 (Iowa City)Dec. 18, 1981: Iowa 80, Clemson 68 (Houston)Dec. 17, 1962: Iowa 74, Clemson 64 (Iowa City)Two players from that 2022 game remain on Clemson's roster. Current leading scorer RJ Godfrey played nine minutes off the bench as a freshman, scoring 7 points on 3-for-3 shooting and grabbing a rebound. Guard Dillon Hunter played one minute and did not record any statistics. Hunter is now averaging 7.5 points per game as a senior for the Tigers.Iowa won that game by three points after a 21-point effort from Patrick McCaffery.KCCI 8: Road to the Final FourTune in from 6:30 to 7 p.m. Wednesday for a special NCAA Tournament preview show.
